content:
{'text': '[0] Bloomberg 的 Mark Gurman 今日撰文指，蘋果計劃讓廣受歡迎嘅陶瓷 Apple Watch 強勢回歸。Gurman 更表示，新款陶瓷 Apple Watch 最快可能會於今年開賣。', 'translate': "Bloomberg's Mark Gurman wrote today that Apple plans to bring back the popular ceramic Apple Watch in a big way. Gurman also stated that the new ceramic Apple Watch could go on sale as early as this year."}

{'text': '[1] 陶瓷錶款嘅最後一次發售係 2019 年嘅「Apple Watch Edition Series 5」，當時蘋果仍以 Edition 品牌命名佢哋用上更高級材質嘅頂級型號。', 'translate': "The ceramic model was last sold in 2019 with the 'Apple Watch Edition Series 5,' when Apple still used the Edition brand to name its top-tier models featuring higher-end materials."}

{'text': '[2] 距離上一次列入產品線已近七年，陶瓷 Apple Watch 已經成為收藏家趨之若鶩嘅稀有逸品。呢種錶殼材質擁有極具視覺震撼力嘅深邃亮澤，而且抗刮能力極強。', 'translate': 'Nearly seven years since it was last part of the product lineup, the ceramic Apple Watch has become a rare collectible highly sought after by enthusiasts. This case material boasts a strikingly deep, lustrous sheen and excellent scratch resistance.'}

{'text': '[3] 蘋果最初係喺 Apple Watch Series 2 推出白色陶瓷版本，Series 3 加入黑色陶瓷款，Series 4 就將兩種陶瓷顏色完全取消，到 Series 5 又重新返嚟淨係返白色陶瓷。該版本隨住 2020 年 Series 6 推出而停產。', 'translate': 'Apple initially introduced the white ceramic version with the Apple Watch Series 2, added a black ceramic option with Series 3, completely dropped both ceramic colors for Series 4, then brought back only the white ceramic for Series 5. That version was discontinued when the Series 6 launched in 2020.'}

{'text': '[4] 以下係 Mark 喺佢最新一期《Power On》電子報中，對呢款產品回歸嘅描述：', 'translate': "Below is Mark's description of the product's return in his latest issue of the 'Power On' newsletter:"}

{'text': '[5] 提提大家，目前 Watch Series 11 提供鋁金屬或鈦金屬版本，Apple Watch Ultra 就僅限鈦金屬。鈦金屬錶款起跳價為 699 美元，而最平嘅 Series 11 售價為 399 美元。', 'translate': 'As a reminder, the current Watch Series 11 is available in aluminum or titanium, while the Apple Watch Ultra is offered exclusively in titanium. Titanium models start at $699, while the most affordable Series 11 is priced at $399.'}

{'text': '[6] 我哋預期陶瓷將會作為更高級嘅頂級材質選項登場。以 Series 5 陶瓷 Apple Watch 為參考，該起跳價為 1299 美元。', 'translate': 'We expect ceramic to debut as a higher-end, premium material option. Using the Series 5 ceramic Apple Watch as a reference, the starting price was $1,299.'}
